main_resume: The initial session ended before all blocks completed. The same fixed search modules and protocol were resumed from atomic completed-block caches. Original per-run timing was retained for cached blocks.
reference_input_fix: The elkai bridge rejected triangular EXPLICIT storage before producing tours. The three affected inputs were losslessly expanded to FULL_MATRIX and rerun with the same five reference seeds. All other references were retained. No best-of-retry selection was performed.
timing_interpretation: Per-process CPU seconds exclude JIT warmup and include run initialization and diagnostics. Wall seconds can include scheduling contention. There is no equal-time comparison with LKH or between the two experimental sessions.
source_boundary: The protocol retains the exact launch runner and its hash. Distribution-runner changes concern public input acquisition, wording, and EXPLICIT serialization. Population and ILS search modules are unchanged.
